dataList.content:
Thank you, Dante.
谢谢你，但丁。

Children who were trapped within the department store... can finally feel the sunshine of the world outside.
多亏了你，被关在这家百货店里的孩子们……这下也能感受到外面的阳光了。

<... I want to ask you something.>
<……我想问你一些事。>

<When people Distort... they always talk to themselves like they can hear your voice.>
<每当人们扭曲时……他们自言自语的样子，仿佛是听见了你的声音。>

<Are you... the one who creates Distortions?>
<是你……创造了扭曲吗？>

Distortions, huh...
扭曲啊……

No, not at all. The phenomenon you decided to call "Distortions" is just an external expression of values.
没这回事哦。被你们称为扭曲的现象……只不过是价值观的外在表现。

I'm just a mirror reflecting people's hearts, so that they can be more honest with themselves.
我只是映照出人们的内心，从而令人们对自己的内心更加坦诚。

<But the way those people inside the department store look, I'm... I'm not sure how they're supposed to be expressions of personal values.>
<百货店里那些人的模样……可不太像是什么价值观的外在表现。>

As we've discussed, values can be educated and injected. This is what leads to seemingly cookie-cutter, standardized appearances you saw in the customers of the Grand Magasin Sisyphe.
价值观……是可以被教育或注入的，你应该也清楚。如此一来人就会变得像西西弗百货的顾客们一样，成为定型化的存在。

If your set of values, which draws the line between Good and Evil, resembles those of others... the shape of your hearts end up looking quite similar.
如果一个人分辨善恶的价值观与他人相仿……那这些人内心的样貌当然也不会差太多。

It's a shame, if you ask me. I was hoping to see people effloresce their inner uniqueness, free from the influences of others.
真令人惋惜。我希望的是人们能不受任何影响，绽放出独属于自己的个性。

<... When you say "effloresce," are you talking about efflorescing E.G.O?>
<……你说的“绽放”是指E.G.O吗？>

When positive emotional fluctuation occurs, from negativity to positivity, the resultant energy can be used by each individual to summon external manifestations of their appearances—and their hearts. That was our Singularity.
当消极情绪变为积极情绪，并产生情感落差时，人可以用那股能量展现自我的样貌，实现心灵具象化。那就是我们的奇点。

Of course, negative emotions don't always manifest as Distortions, and positive emotions don't always manifest as E.G.O.
消极情绪并不意味着扭曲，积极情绪也并不意味着E.G.O。

The direction of one's manifestation is contingent on the user's will.
这只取决于当事人自己的意愿，取决于人们在心灵具象化时想选择哪个方向。

But tools and clothes... they're no different from the shackles that bind us, the shapes of our hearts defined by culture, which is by its nature acquired and unnatural.
但道具与服装的形式……也无异于一种束缚。它们的形态……会被人们后天形成的文化所影响。

<You... dislike E.G.O, don't you?>
<你好像……不怎么喜欢E.G.O。>

Dislike? No, why would I? That shape you call E.G.O used to be a perfect fit for my values, which is why I once pursued it.
怎么会呢？E.G.O可是我的价值观曾经所追求的形态哦？

I used to think that... if we humans were to reveal our true selves, if we were nothing but our true selves, we would be reduced to wild, incoherently screaming animals.
我以前认为……人要是只顾展露出自我的样貌，就无法互相沟通……那样的人跟发脾气的野兽没有区别。

So, I intended to leave the smallest trace of that cultural morpheme—our last rule, in its most unobtrusive form.
所以我打算制定规则……至少保留一些文化元素。

But moments before death took me, I realized... how that would be denying humans the wholeness of their true selves.
但是……后来我在死亡面前领悟到，那终究算不上是……完整的自我。

I don't hate E.G.O. I don't "dislike" it, either—I just find it regrettable. But I want to respect that choice.
我并不憎恨或厌恶E.G.O，我只是感到遗憾而已。但我想尊重那种选择。

I want to respect my old self, and the values of my junior who silently observes it all from the light.
我尊重自己的老想法，我也尊重在光中默默贯彻着老想法的我那后辈的价值观。

<We're... working to stop the Distortions. We've also met some who take the approach of therapy.>
<我们……正致力于阻止扭曲。我们还见过一些试图采取治疗的人。>

<Is there any way to... stop this phenomenon? Will this never go away?>
<这种现象……会一直持续下去，永不停止吗？>

Hmm... Yeah, I really hope someone comes up with a better name for it someday. Calling someone who has chosen to become their true, whole self a "Distortion"... doesn't sit right with me.
我果然还是觉得……要是有人能重新为这种现象命名就好了。把一个人选择完整的自我，并成为完整的自我的过程称作扭曲……确实不太令人满意。

So, Dante. The crux of your question can be summarized as this: how does one erase this new law I have painted onto the world—the laws governing the materialization of the heart and the consequent phenomenon?
但丁，总而言之你想知道怎样才能抹除我那新描绘的心灵具象化法则与现象……

There has to be a way, I think. Every "problem" has a solution, after all.
应该会有办法的，毕竟世上没有毫无对策的问题。

If you—or anyone—manage to find that way and erase the light that materializes the heart... That same light, which the junior I'm so proud of and the child who resembles me have allowed to spread throughout the City...
如果你或其他人找到了那种办法……消除那道我引以为傲的后辈以及很像我的孩子散播在都市中的光……消除那股令人心灵具象化的力量……

... Then, I suppose, that also warrants respect.
那我将对此表示尊重。

Because I, too, have had to overcome the status quo to define my own set of rules.
毕竟我也战胜了现有的规则，并重新定义了我自己的规则。

But... I won't let that happen so easily. I will do everything in my power to stop it.
但是……我不会乖乖地让你抹除它。我会尽我所能阻止你。

Dante, as much as I would like to continue this conversation... I cannot divulge everything just yet, and it seems that your ears are yet to be fully opened.
但丁，虽然我想和你多聊几句……但我现在能说的东西并不多，而你能听清的东西也很少。

Now, hurry along to Sisyphe Tower. Gotta save Meur, right?
快去西西弗塔吧。你要去救默尔，不是吗？

Ah, wait! Before you go, Dante... you should add the Library to your itinerary.
啊，对了！但丁。找机会去一趟图书馆吧。

There, you'll find something you've been seeking.
到了那里，你就会找到一些你想知道的东西了。

<Why—>
<为什么……>

Why am I telling you this?
我为什么会告诉你这件事？

Guess I just have a soft spot for people who struggle toward the light. Makes me want to cheer them on, you know?
因为我总想为努力走向光明的人加油。
